text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... nobody's here. I could've sworn 
someone called me, though...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, the Three Goddesses. I always feel a 
tiny bit of kinship with them♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Cheval-chi's in charge of "Courage"~ and 
big sis Verxina's in charge of 
"Discipline"♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
A-And, I'm in charge of "Love"♪ 'Cause I 
loooove you both so much!♡
